description: Channel and technology partners. Two fundamentally different motions live here: sell-THROUGH, where the partner transacts and owns the customer relationship, and sell-WITH, where you transact but win together. They are measured differently and must never be summed into one 'partner revenue' number.

columns.name: motion
columns.note: THE defining field. Sell-through: they transact, margin applies, you may not see the end customer. Sell-with: you transact, no margin, the partner brings access or completes the solution.

columns.name: roles_supported
columns.note: Semicolon-separated tiers this partner may occupy: Distributor;Reseller;Referral;Technology. A partner can hold more than one — Carahsoft acting as both distributor and reseller on the same deal is normal, not a conflict. partner_type records what they primarily are; this records what they're permitted to do.

columns.name: exclusive_territory
columns.note: Whether the agreement grants exclusivity in their region/segment. Exclusive overlaps are a contract breach, not just an awkward conversation.

columns.name: countries
columns.note: Semicolon-separated. Territory is checked against this, not against free-text region.

columns.name: named_accounts
columns.note: Semicolon-separated accounts assigned specifically to this partner, overriding territory.

columns.name: excluded_accounts
columns.note: Accounts this partner may NOT register — usually direct-managed or assigned elsewhere.

columns.name: margin_pct
columns.note: Sell-through only. Blank for sell-with — a technology partner has no margin, and a blank here is meaningful rather than missing.

columns.name: integration_type
columns.note: Sell-with: how the products connect — API, MDM, CI/CD, SIEM

columns.name: joint_solution
columns.note: What the combined offer actually does for a customer

columns.name: owner
columns.note: Our partner manager

columns.name: enablement_status
columns.note: Sell-through partners who can't demo don't sell. Lapsed certification is a leading indicator of a dormant partner.

columns.name: deals_registered
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: deals_open
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: deals_won
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: deals_lost
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: pipeline_open
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: revenue_won
columns.note: DERIVED. Gross. Net of margin is a different number — say which you're quoting.

columns.name: revenue_net
columns.note: DERIVED: revenue_won less margin, for sell-through only

columns.name: win_rate
columns.note: DERIVED %. Blank when the sample is too small.

columns.name: avg_deal_size
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: first_deal_date
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: last_deal_date
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: months_since_last_deal
columns.note: DERIVED. The single best signal of a partner going quiet.

columns.name: health
columns.note: DERIVED from recency, pipeline, and enablement — not from how the relationship feels

columns.name: risk_flags
columns.note: DERIVED: no-deals-90d;enablement-lapsed;agreement-expiring;single-rep-dependency;no-qbr
